summary: Iteration 113 — verified 3-part fix for the 'production images vanish after redeploy' bug: (A) TIGRIS DURABILITY on every image write, (B) SELF-HEAL flagship-art endpoint, (C) admin 'Heal artwork' UI button. Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS against live Tigris (STORAGE_BACKEND=tigris, bucket bigfm-storage). Verified: (1) POST /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/generate on NON-flagship (imp_780122061aa111e9a8 MANGORADIO) polls to complete with a plain /api/static/station_artwork/<hash>.webp key that EXISTS in Tigris via get_storage().exists(key=...). Prompt confirmed to NOT contain 'lower third' — non-flagship regression intact. (2) Same call on FLAGSHIP (imp_fun_big_1062_uae) produces a flg-<hash>.webp key that EXISTS in Tigris, and the prompt DOES contain the 'lower third' reservation phrasing — flagship regression intact. (3) Cache-hit backfill: deleted the just-generated key from Tigris via storage.delete(), re-called generate → source='cached' path re-uploads the on-disk WebP to Tigris (get_storage().exists() flips back to True). Confirms _upload_durable check-then-upload behaviour in image_gen.py:65. (4) Admin owner upload (128×128 PNG) → returned art_url key EXISTS in Tigris (persist_uploaded_bytes now durable). (5) Helper routes.imported_station_artwork._static_asset_missing: returns False for None / external URL / ui-avatars / present /api/static file; returns True for a bogus /api/static path. (6) POST /api/imported-stations/ensure-flagship-art idempotent: two consecutive calls, second's `queued` <= first's. (7) Vanished-art simulation: set a flagship's art_url to '/api/static/station_artwork/does-not-exist-xyz-iter113.webp' via direct Mongo write with art_gen_attempted=False + artwork_status=complete → POST ensure-flagship-art queued>=1 (self-heal correctly detected the vanished file). Original values restored after. Frontend web (/admin/flagship-stations): [data-testid=admin-flagship-heal-art] button visible in Fleet health row next to Run health check + Re-seed manifest, labelled 'Heal artwork' with Sparkles icon. Clicking fires POST ensure-flagship-art and shows [data-testid=admin-flagship-toast] with text 'All flagship artwork is healthy' (since all 11 flagships already have valid Tigris-persisted art from prior iteration). Per-row [data-testid=admin-flagship-big-1062-uae-gen-art] and [data-testid=admin-flagship-big-1062-uae-upload-art] still present and functional (previous iteration). Full 11-row table renders with thumbnails. No console errors of significance.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/image_gen.py:65 _upload_durable currently does an exists() check on EVERY generate() call for cache-hit code path (line 200). On a hot station this is one Tigris HEAD per request — cheap (<50ms) but non-zero. Consider a short in-process LRU of 'known-present keys' to skip the HEAD after the first confirmation.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:234 ensure_flagship_art still uses .limit(50) — up from 12 in iter112. Fine for today's fleet (11 flagships) but if a caller has hundreds this silently truncates. Consider paging (batch loop until cursor exhausted) since this endpoint is idempotent + admin-only anyway.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:203 _static_asset_missing only recognises URLs starting with '/api/static/'. Owner uploads via persist_uploaded_bytes and AI outputs both use this prefix, so it works today — but flagship_art fields that were ever set to a full absolute URL (e.g. an early Tigris presigned URL) will be treated as OK. Non-blocking (external URLs really are OK) but worth noting in comments.

backend/services/image_gen.py:243 persist_uploaded_bytes uploads durable AFTER local write. If the local disk write succeeds but the Tigris upload fails silently (logged as WARN only), the DB will point at a /api/static url that only lives on the current pod — same class of bug as before the fix, just narrower. Consider surfacing durable_ok in the returned dict so routes can retry.

backend/services/image_gen.py:200 _upload_durable inside the cache-hit branch is best-effort: log.warning-only on failure. If the durable write persistently fails (bad creds), every generate() call becomes an implicit no-op for durability, and no metric surfaces the drift. A small counter (STATSD/Prometheus) or a periodic sanity task would help ops detect this class of silent failure.
seed_data_creation: During testing (all idempotent + reverted): (a) imp_780122061aa111e9a8 (MANGORADIO) had AI art generated to /api/static/station_artwork/e979ea1cee8556bf13866a2a.webp (Tigris-backed), then that key was deleted from Tigris + regenerated (source=cached, backfilled), then finally overwritten by an owner PNG upload to /api/static/station_artwork/upload-imp-imp_780122061aa111e9a8.webp (art_source='owner'). (b) imp_fun_big_1062_uae had its flg-*.webp key confirmed present in Tigris; the vanished-simulation test temporarily set art_url to a bogus path but RESTORED the original after (via a try/finally block in test_ensure_flagship_art_regenerates_vanished).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live evidence (iter113, 2026-06 fork, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.com, STORAGE_BACKEND=tigris, bucket=bigfm-storage): The full 3-part durability fix is live and passing. Public surface: (1) POST /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/generate — flagship vs non-flagship branch on is_flagship OR flagship_slug; both now durable-write via _upload_durable / get_storage().upload_bytes. (2) POST /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/upload — persist_uploaded_bytes now calls _upload_durable. (3) POST /api/imported-stations/ensure-flagship-art — self-heal loop with .limit(50), checks _static_asset_missing per row, idempotent. (4) Helper _static_asset_missing at routes/imported_station_artwork.py:203 — checks disk THEN Tigris exists(). Returns False for external / None / present, True only for /api/static/* absent from both. UI selector [data-testid=admin-flagship-heal-art] on /admin/flagship-stations (AdminFlagshipStations.jsx:261) fires healArt() which POSTs to ensure-flagship-art and toasts [data-testid=admin-flagship-toast]. Pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter113_artwork_durability.py loads /app/backend/.env before importing services.object_storage (mandatory for get_storage() to pick tigris backend outside the FastAPI process).
rca of the issue: N/A — fix (A) Tigris durability, (B) self-heal endpoint, (C) admin Heal button are all working end-to-end on backend + web.
